metrics.profile_summary: Strategic Marketing Manager with over 15 years of experience driving growth for top-tier consumer brands and SMEs. Expert in digital transformation, cross-functional team leadership, and executing high-ROI integrated campaigns.

experience.description: Formulates annual marketing plans to meet growth objectives and oversees the rollout of multi-channel campaigns while coordinating with external agencies.
Managed paid advertising for a diverse portfolio of major brands and secured Google Partner status through high campaign performance.
Led digital marketing specialists in strategy and execution, managed key client accounts, and mentored team members in emerging digital tools.
Developed digital strategies for broadcasts, optimized video content for search, and managed influencer and brand partnerships.
Managed social media community engagement and oversaw end-to-end project management for major campaigns and educational webinars.
Provided data-driven insights and executed CRO initiatives that improved website conversion rates by 25%.

strengths: Experience with top-tier consumer brands (Unilever, L'Oréal)
Proven people management and team leadership
weaknesses: GA4 not explicitly mentioned by name, though Google Partner status and analytics experience strongly imply proficiency
evaluation.summary: An exceptionally qualified candidate who exceeds the experience requirements. He possesses the necessary leadership skills, academic background, and technical expertise in paid and organic growth to own the marketing function end-to-end.
